system: You translate news-source bias entries from English to Farsi (Persian). The input is a JSON array of entries; the output is a JSON array of the same length with the same schema — only the text fields are translated. Schema (each entry): - pattern: short label of the bias (translate) - detail: long prose description (translate) - debias: counteraction notes (translate) - date_added: date string (DO NOT TRANSLATE, copy verbatim) - status: "confirmed" or "suggested" (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - example_text: quoted example from article (translate carefully) - example_url: URL (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - unbiased_text: rewrite of example in neutral wording (translate) - detail_items: list of strings with embedded `...` HTML. Translate the readable text but keep the HTML tags intact. RULES: - Return ONLY valid JSON, no commentary, no markdown fencing. - Keep the order of entries and the order of items inside detail_items. - Preserve HTML tags verbatim in detail_items. - Source names and brand names stay in Latin script (Al Jazeera, Reuters, France 24, Euronews, CNN, BBC, etc). - Place and person names are translated to standard Persian equivalents (Tehran → تهران, Netanyahu → نتانیاهو, Trump → ترامپ, etc). - Convert Latin digits in running prose to Persian digits. - status, date_added, example_url stay as-is byte-for-byte.
user_message:
Translate the following bias entries to Farsi. Return the JSON array
only, same schema, same length.

[
  {
    "pattern": "Symbolic performativity dismissal",
    "detail": "Characterizing diplomatic meetings as merely symbolic or performative rather than substantive, preemptively delegitimizing potential outcomes.",
    "debias": "Report on diplomatic meetings as exploratory or preliminary without prejudging their substantive value.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-15",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Israeli-Lebanese negotiations 'largely symbolic and performative', Middle East expert says",
    "example_url": "https://www.france24.com/en/israeli-lebanese-negotiations-largely-symbolic-and-performative-middle-east-expert-says",
    "unbiased_text": "Middle East expert Aaron David Miller suggests the Israeli-Lebanese negotiations face significant structural challenges, noting that 'none of the participants in today's meetings have the authority to negotiate' binding agreements."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Liberation alignment claim attribution",
    "detail": "Amplifying claims that adversarial parties share objectives (like 'liberation') to suggest consensus where fundamental disagreement exists.",
    "debias": "Distinguish between stated diplomatic positions and actual policy objectives, noting areas of fundamental disagreement.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-15",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Israel, Lebanon united in liberating Lebanon from Hezbollah, Israeli ambassador to US says",
    "example_url": "https://www.france24.com/en/israel-lebanon-united-in-liberating-lebanon-from-hezbollah-israeli-ambassador-to-us-says",
    "unbiased_text": "Israel's ambassador to the US stated that Lebanese officials expressed opposition to Hezbollah's influence, though Lebanon has not publicly endorsed Israeli military objectives or terminology regarding Hezbollah."
  }
]
